scope: Programming session initialization and cleanup cancellation; synthetic command failures plus existing owned native database session acceptance. Full Toolkit and physical-device parity remain incomplete.
corrected_behavior: First body or initializer error survives a secondary cleanup interruption
KeyboardInterrupt and SystemExit during initialization trigger cleanup only for confirmed owned resources on a usable connection
Cleanup stops after interruption or connection loss without reconnecting or issuing another command
Cancellation during cleanup with no earlier failure remains the same exception
CLI preserves the original error and emits bounded cleanup errors
Unconfirmed lock acquisition never triggers unlock or lock cancellation
limits: Lost or interrupted LOCK/START replies may leave server resource state uncertain; no inference of ownership or release is made
No automatic reconnection or reclamation of uncertain remote resources
